messages:
maria (PM): quick sync — we need a short cross-func engineering sync next week to go over 2 RFCs (inference routing, rollout policies), plus roadmap slotting questions. prefer 30m. who can own agenda items?
jon (Eng): +1. prefer morning PT. can take the routing RFC if needed.
lee (Platform): I can do rollout policies section, have some perf numbers to share. mornings are tight for me Tue/Wed.
anita (Design): can join for the UX implications + decision tradeoffs. Tue afternoon works best for me.
david (SRE): will attend for SLAs/fallbacks. any doc links?
maria (PM): linking RFCs: https://redwood.company/rfcs/178-routing and https://redwood.company/rfcs/182-rollout-policies. also want a short decision-log entry for any product/infra tradeoffs.
sam (Product): I can own roadmap slotting discussion and priority tradeoffs (5–7 mins).
jon (Eng): +1 to decision log. suggest we capture canary guardrails and fallback model mapping.
maria (PM): proposed time poll: 3 options — Mon 9:30 PT, Tue 11:00 PT, Wed 8:30 PT. reply with the option or "any". :calendar:
lee (Platform): Tue 11:00 PT doesn't work for me; Wed 8:30 PT ok.
anita (Design): Tue 11:00 PT works if we keep to 30m.
david (SRE): Mon 9:30 PT for me.
jon (Eng): Wed 8:30 PT preferred.
sam (Product): Tue 11:00 PT or Wed 8:30 PT both ok.
maria (PM): tally: Mon: david; Tue: anita, sam; Wed: jon, lee, sam. seems Wed 8:30 PT has biggest coverage — provisional.
maria (PM): Agenda draft: 1) quick status + metrics (lee) 2) routing RFC high-level review (jon) 3) rollout policies + canary rules (lee) 4) roadmap slotting & priority tradeoffs (sam) 5) decision log + next steps (maria). please flag changes.
jon (Eng): can we add a 3-min block for "impact on cache/batching"? small perf note.
maria (PM): added as 2a.
anita (Design): tiny ask — include one example flow for end-to-end UX regression risk. I'll drop a screenshot in the RFC thread.
deploy-bot: reminder — please add calendar invite after time confirmed. (automated)
maria (PM): action items: jon & lee prepare 5–7 slide bullets each, sam to summarize priority ask in 2 bullets, anita to attach UX example. I'll create calendar invite for Wed 8:30 PT and decision-log stub.
lee (Platform): noted. will post perf numbers and a short runbook snippet: `if canary_error_rate > 0.5% then rollback -> notify-sre`
david (SRE): thanks — I'll review runbook and add an ops contact.
jon (Eng): pinging @eng-reviews for a quick code-review on the routing change — if merged before Wed we can demo.
maria (PM): thanks team. if anyone can't make it, add comments in the RFCs and I'll pull into the decision log. :thumbsup:
